reviewer_guidance: Evaluate each claim from the total evidence, accounting for correlated sources and explicit counterevidence. Consider shot timing, lip activity, original acoustics, diarization reliability, and recorded uncertainty. The treatment and salience flags express a tunable attention policy rather than calibrated probabilities. Abstain when attribution is unresolved. Never invent phonemes or characters from context.

rules.rationale: Animation may not accurately follow phoneme timing; still examine movement, edits and counterevidence.
Synchrony in live-action can support active-speaker attribution, but reaction cuts and offscreen speech remain possible.
Source audio/video synchronization has not been established.
On-screen caption is not an independent observation of the actual acoustic word.
